capability: Herschel-Bulkley yield-flow path (src/lib.rs:1227) evaluated at published fitted parameters (tau_0, K, n) from a rights-clean CC BY 4.0 real-data source: Amorim, Oliveira, Mancini & Sirqueira (2021) SN Applied Sciences 3:236, doi:10.1007/s42452-021-04247-7 -- commercial DGEBA epoxy/polyamide anti-corrosion coating, control + 5 carbon-black/nanoclay formulations, steady-shear 0.1-100 s^-1, 25C, R^2>0.998 for all 6 fits. This is PARAMETER-LEVEL reproduction (module equation evaluated at the paper's own published tau_0/K/n and cross-checked against the paper's own stated Fig.3 axis bounds and ranking claims), not a raw (gamma_dot, eta) point-level regression -- the source paper does not tabulate raw flow-curve points.
krieger_dougherty_status: KRIEGER_DOUGHERTY (pigment/filler volume-fraction crowding, src/lib.rs:1208) remains UNBENCHMARKED in-tree. No rights-clean pigment/filler volume-fraction viscosity ladder was located during the parent audit's open-literature sweep (MDPI Coatings/Polymers, RSC Advances, ACS Omega, Scientific Reports, Frontiers, SN Applied Sciences). This is a genuine data gap, filed to the data-acquisition-queue, not a rights-quarantine of an identified asset.

locale_repair_provenance.control_arm_result: The literal-English reading of the SAME as-printed table (comma = thousands separator, i.e. what a downstream engineer would transcribe verbatim) fails the paper's own axis bounds by 13x-1500x for every one of the 6 formulations. This control arm is the falsifying observation the attack was pre-registered to surface, and it DID fire -- just for the wrong/naive reading, not the corrected one.
locale_repair_provenance.issue: As-printed Table 2 typesets every tau_0/K value with a comma before the final 3 digits, while n/R2/MRD in the same table use a period -- a Word/Excel-to-PDF locale (comma-decimal) mixup affecting only the thousands-scale columns.
locale_repair_provenance.repair: Last comma read as the decimal separator (European/Brazilian locale convention consistent with the corresponding author's Brazilian institutional affiliation), independently justified by cross-checking against the paper's OWN stated Fig.3 apparent-viscosity axis metadata (1 to 1e5 Pa.s) -- not by fitting the repair to make the module's equation look good.

metrics.name: corrected_reading_all_within_paper_axis_bounds
metrics.note: All 6 formulations' apparent viscosity (locale-repaired reading) lands inside the paper's own stated Fig.3 axis range [1, 1e5] Pa.s at all 4 tested shear rates.

metrics.name: corrected_reading_all_monotonic_shear_thinning
metrics.note: All 6 formulations n<1 and apparent viscosity monotonically decreasing with shear rate, matching the paper's own stated finding.

metrics.name: paper_ranking_claims_reproduced
metrics.note: Sample 4 = max yield stress (tau_0), unmodified epoxy control = min consistency coefficient (K), reproducing the paper's own stated ranking.

metrics.name: literal_reading_control_arm_fails_axis_bounds
metrics.note: Control arm: literal-English (naive transcription) reading of the same table fails the paper's own axis bounds by 13x-1500x for all 6 formulations -- confirms the attack was genuinely capable of falsifying and did fire, just not for the justified reading.

population: Commercial DGEBA epoxy/polyamide marine/anti-corrosion coating, control + 5 carbon-black/nanoclay formulations, 25C, steady shear 0.1-100 s^-1.
scope_limits: Single commercial resin family (JUMBO-grade DGEBA epoxy / polyamide).

Parameter-level benchmark only -- module equation evaluated AT published fitted tau_0/K/n, cross-checked against the paper's own reported axis range and ranking claims. No raw (gamma_dot, eta) point-level regression was performed or is possible from this source (paper tabulates only fitted parameters and a graphical Fig.3, not raw flow-curve data points).
Does not establish Herschel-Bulkley adequacy across coating chemistries, resin families, or temperatures.

theory: Herschel, W.H. & Bulkley, R. (1926) 'Konsistenzmessungen von Gummi-Benzollosungen', Kolloid-Zeitschrift 39:291-300. eta_apparent(gamma_dot) = tau_0/gamma_dot + K*gamma_dot^(n-1).
